sources.title: Dawn – LDA locks horns with real estate group (Feb 2013)

name: Bahria Orchard
approval_note: LDA approved list: Phase-I (3,737.55 kanals, mouzas Paji & Raiwind) 'Approved by TMA in 2009' (28-07-2009). LDA illegal list: Phase-II, Phase-II Extension (aka Ph-V), Sector G, Sector H and Phase-IV.
description: Bahria Town project on Raiwind Road and Sharif Medical City Road, Raiwind tehsil. Only Phase I appears on LDA's approved list (3,737.55 kanals, about 467 acres); several later phases are on LDA's illegal list.

sources.title: The News – Record of 103 housing schemes seized (Sep 2014)

name: Lake City
approval_note: LDA approved list: Lake City Bella Vista (partial revision, 9,126.03 kanals) finally approved 26-04-2022; Lake City Bella Verde (6,746.04 kanals) approved 12-01-2021. A separate 392.51-kanal 'unapproved pockets' entry has no stage shown.
description: Two LDA-approved schemes (Bella Vista and Bella Verde) in mouzas Halloki, Janjaty and Khananepal on Raiwind Road, Raiwind tehsil. Area and unit counts are from LDA's records (residential + commercial plots).

name: Park View City Lahore
approval_note: Original 'River Edge' scheme (765.05 kanals, Mouza Shahpur Khanpur, Multan Road) is on LDA's approved list as finally approved. Profit (Nov 2022) reports LDA refused extension beyond 765 kanals and issued notices; the name change to Park View was not approved.
possession_status: Society said in 2022 that over 4,000 homes were built
description: Started as River Edge in 2004 (LDA-approved 2006) and was bought and renamed by Vision Developers in 2010. Lies on Multan Road near Thokar Niaz Baig; area and units shown are only the 765-kanal LDA-approved River Edge layout, and the built footprint is larger.

sources.title: LDA – Approved Private Housing Schemes (River Edge)
Profit – Up a river without a paddle (Oct 2022)
Profit – Punjab minister castigates Aleem Khan's Park View society (Nov 2022)

name: Lahore Smart City
approval_note: LDA approved list: 'Lahore Smart City', Mouza/Chak No. 42, 43 & 44 Hardosohal, 2,153 kanals, 'Finally approved' (no date shown). The marketed project is reportedly larger; check which phases the approval covers.
description: On the Lahore Eastern Bypass near Kala Shah Kaku, in Ferozewala tehsil (Sheikhupura District), just outside Lahore district. The area shown is the 2,153 kanals on LDA's approved list.

name: Etihad Town
approval_note: LDA approved list: Etihad Town (Phase I, 2,200.38 kanals) finally approved 03-12-2024; Phase-II (2,478.53 kanals, Mouza Jedu), Premier Enclave (401.84 kanals) and Phase IV (261.15 kanals) technically approved only.
description: Phase I is in mouzas Rakh Khamba and Ameerpura; Phase II is in Mouza Jedu and Phase IV in Asal Suleman. Area and units are totals of the four LDA records (residential + commercial plots).

name: Al-Kabir Town
approval_note: LDA approved list: 'Al-Kabir Town' (Mouza Janjaty, 239.85 kanals, blocks A & B) finally approved. LDA illegal list: 'Al-Kabir Down Town' (Raiwind Road), 'Al-Kabir Apartment Homes' (Mouza Tarogil) and 'Alkabir Town (Umar Block project)'.
description: Raiwind Road scheme. Only a 239.85-kanal section (blocks A and B, 573 plots) is LDA-approved, and several related Al-Kabir projects are on LDA's illegal list, so check the exact block before buying.

name: Central Park Housing Scheme
approval_note: LDA approved list: Central Park Phase-II (revised, 971.5 kanals) approved 16-10-2024 (final approval first granted 24-09-2021); Phase-III (294.70 kanals) approved 07-03-2023.
description: Scheme in mouzas Baddoki, Asal Suleman, Atto Asal and Ladhekey Bhullar. Area and units are the Phase II (revised) and Phase III LDA records combined.

name: Valencia Town
approval_note: LDA approved list: Valencia Town Ph-I–IV (7,322.55 kanals, blocks A–P) approved 22-05-1999; Ph-V (1,121.50 kanals) approved 10-08-2004. 'Valencia Valley' (Pine Avenue Road) is a different scheme on LDA's illegal list.
description: Established scheme in mouzas Sadhoki and Dharam Chand near Wapda Town and NFC, Model Town tehsil. Don't confuse it with 'Valencia Valley', which is on LDA's illegal list.

name: Wapda Town (WAPDA Employees Cooperative Housing Society)
approval_note: LDA approved list: WAPDA ECHS Ph-I (9,280.55 kanals), Ph-I Extension (388 kanals) and Ph-II (1,817.55 kanals) all marked 'Approved' (no dates shown).
description: Large established cooperative society in mouzas Sattokatla and Rakh Khamba, Model Town tehsil, near Johar Town and Valencia.

name: Johar Town (LDA)
approval_note: LDA's own public-sector scheme (described by Dawn, Jun 2024, as LDA's biggest housing scheme). The private Gulshan-e-Mustafa scheme (LDA-approved 1980) was later absorbed into it.
description: LDA's largest housing scheme at over 26,000 kanals (area_acres is that figure divided by 8), in two phases (blocks A–G and G2–R). It is in Lahore's Iqbal zone in the south-west of the city.

sources.title: Dawn – Digitisation helps LDA identify 3,200 plots in Johar Town (Jun 2024)

name: Model Town
approval_authority: Registrar Cooperative Societies Punjab (Model Town Society); extension blocks under LDA
approval_note: Pre-partition cooperative society (registered 1924); not on LDA's private-scheme lists, so no LDA approval status applies.
possession_status: Fully settled
description: Garden-city cooperative founded in the early 1920s on Diwan Khem Chand's plan, with ten blocks (A–K) around a central park. The outer blocks (L–S) form Model Town Extension under LDA.

name: Askari X (Askari 10)
approval_note: Army-sponsored scheme in Lahore Cantonment tehsil; not on LDA's lists and no official approval record found.
description: Askari sector in Lahore Cantonment near Allama Iqbal International Airport.

name: Askari XI (Askari 11)
approval_note: Army-sponsored scheme; not on LDA's lists and no official approval record found.
description: Askari sector on Bedian Road next to DHA Phase V, with Sectors A, B and C (Sector C also called Shuhada Town). Coordinates are an OSM point in Sector C.

name: Paragon City
approval_authority: LDA (claimed earlier TMA Aziz Bhatti Town approval)
approval_note: Dawn (27 Nov 2018) reported NAB's statement that the society 'has not yet been approved by the LDA' and that its claimed TMA approval was disputed. Not on LDA's current approved or illegal lists; current status unverified.
description: Scheme in Lahore Cantonment tehsil bounded by Barki Road and the Ring Road, near the airport. The developer claims 7,000+ kanals and 8,000+ families. Its official site currently carries injected spam content.

sources.title: Dawn – Paragon director becomes approver against Saad Rafique (Nov 2018)

name: Lahore Motorway City
approval_note: Not on LDA's approved or illegal lists; no official or reputable-news approval record found (portals claim TMA approval — unverified).
description: Scheme north-west of Lahore in Jhugian Sialan, Ferozewala tehsil (Sheikhupura District), near the M-2 motorway.

sources.title: LDA – Approved Private Housing Schemes (not listed)

name: Al Rehman Garden
approval_note: LDA approved list shows only Al-Rehman Garden Ph-III LSD (49.25 kanals, 03-10-2013) and Ph-VI LSD (72.7 kanals, 26-03-2013), both 'TMA Approved', in Kot Dhoni Chand. Other phases, including the large Phase 2, were not found on LDA's approved or illegal lists.
description: Multi-phase scheme in north-east Lahore (GT Road / Sharaqpur Road side). Approval is only verified for two small LDA-listed land sub-divisions, so check the specific phase.

sources.title: Zameen area guide – Al Rehman Garden (pointer only)

name: Formanites Housing Scheme
approval_note: LDA approved list: Formanites Housing Phase-I & II (1,191.30 kanals) — 'Technical approval' dated 30-09-2006; final approval not shown.
description: Scheme in mouzas Kamahan, Jathol, Leil and Wadhwah, next to DHA Phase V and Sector FF Phase 4.

name: Izmir Town
approval_note: LDA approved list: Izmir Town Ph-I (4,241.17 kanals) approved 27-11-2002; Ph-II (459.08 kanals) approved 15-08-2005.
description: Scheme in Mouza Mohlanwal near Chung, Jubilee Town and NESPAK Society Phase II, Raiwind tehsil.

name: LDA City
approval_note: LDA's own public-sector scheme. Plot numbers for 9,712 file holders were balloted on 30 Nov 2019 (Dawn).
possession_status: Possession handed over in stages in Jinnah Sector (Block C from Dec 2023; Blocks K, B, D, E in 2024)
description: LDA-run scheme off Ferozepur Road (Mouza Jedu/Kahna area); Phase 1 is the Jinnah Sector. Possession has been handed over block by block since late 2023.

sources.title: Dawn – LDA City: land arranged to allot plots to 9,700 file holders (Dec 2019)
The News – LDA City allottees to get possession of plots
Business Recorder – LDA achieves record revenue generation from auctions

name: Sukh Chayn Gardens
approval_note: LDA approved list: Sukh Chayn Gardens Housing Scheme (2,132.45 kanals, blocks A–H) approved 25-04-2013.
description: Scheme in mouzas Maraka and Mohlanwal, next to Bahria Town off Multan Road, Raiwind tehsil.

name: Nasheman-e-Iqbal Cooperative Housing Society
approval_note: LDA approved list: Phase-I (1,135 kanals) finally approved (revised plan 21-11-1988); Ph-II Extension (1,195.10 kanals) approved 10-11-2003; Ph-II land sub-division (103.18 kanals, 24-04-1994).
description: Cooperative society off Khayaban-e-Jinnah Road (mouzas Khamba, Bagrian, Sadhoki), next to Wapda Town and near the UET society.

name: Eden City
approval_note: Not on LDA's approved or illegal lists by this name; portals claim LDA approval — unverified.
description: Eden-branded scheme in Lahore Cantonment tehsil next to DHA Phase 8 (Air Avenue), near the airport; not a DHA sector. Coordinates are OSM 'Eden City Park'.

sources.title: Zameen area guide – DHA Phase 8 (pointer only)

name: NFC Employees Cooperative Housing Society (Phase I & II)
approval_note: LDA approved list: NFC Ph-I (2,565.55 kanals, Mouza Sattokatla) approved 12-04-2007; NFC ECHS Phase-II (7,058.69 kanals, mouzas Maraka, Sultankey & Khudpur) approved 09-08-2007.
description: Phase I is near Wapda Town in Mouza Sattokatla. Phase II is a separate, larger site toward Multan Road (Maraka/Sultankey). Coordinates are for Phase I.

name: Fazaia Housing Scheme Lahore
approval_note: LDA approved list: Phase-II (1,444.11 kanals, mouzas Mal & Bhai Kot) approved 14-06-2013; Phase-I (3,940.88 kanals) technically approved 06-02-2024.
description: Scheme on Raiwind Road in mouzas Janjaty, Kot Jewan Mal, Bhalai Gill, Mal and Bhai Kot, near Lake City.

name: Army Welfare Trust (AWT) Housing Scheme
approval_note: LDA approved list: AWT Ph-I (650 kanals, Mouza Rakhpura) approved 07-01-1992; AWT Ph-II (6,151.96 kanals) — 2nd revised layout technically approved 11-03-2024.
description: Phase I is in Mouza Rakhpura (Khizrabad area, Raiwind tehsil); Phase II is in mouzas Asal Lakhowal, Ramkot and Janjaty. Coordinates are for Phase I.

name: New Lahore City
approval_note: LDA approved list: Phase-I (346.9 kanals) approved 03-01-2023; Phase-II (2,054.28 kanals) technical approval 24-07-2018, final pending. LDA illegal list: Phase-III (UBD Canal Road) and Phase-IV (aka Ext / Ph-I Ext, Sundar-Raiwind Road).
description: Scheme in mouzas Maraka, Sultankey and Khudpur toward Sundar-Raiwind Road and UBD Canal. Phases III and IV are on LDA's illegal list; area and units cover only Phases I–II.

name: DHA Karachi (Defence Housing Authority, Phases 1-8)
developer: Pakistan Defence Officers Housing Authority (DHA Karachi)
approval_authority: Statutory authority (Presidential Order No. 7 of 1980); municipal functions with Clifton Cantonment Board
approval_note: Statutory housing authority created by Presidential Order No. 7 of 1980, later validated by the National Assembly; not subject to SBCA/KDA scheme approval lists.
possession_status: Phases 1-7 largely built; Phase 8 still partly vacant
description: Defence Housing Authority's original Karachi estate along the coast, organised in eight phases that grew east and south from Phase 1. The authority traces back to a 1950s cooperative society of retired servicemen.

name: DHA City Karachi (DCK)
approval_note: Developed by DHA Karachi under its statutory powers (Presidential Order No. 7 of 1980); master plan unveiled by the DHA Executive Board in 2011.
possession_status: Under development; DHA balloting and plot sales ongoing in sectors
description: DHA's satellite city on the M-9 Karachi-Hyderabad motorway in Gadap Town, Malir district. The master plan was prepared by a consortium including Doxiadis, RMJM and Osmani & Co.

sources.title: Final master plan of DHA City unveiled (Zameen News)
New plots in DCK (Zameen News, plot sizes)

name: Bahria Town Karachi
approval_authority: Supreme Court of Pakistan (land settlement); Malir Development Authority land
approval_note: SC (4 May 2018) held the MDA land grant/exchange to Bahria illegal and void; on 21 Mar 2019 SC accepted a Rs460bn settlement recognising only the site plan of 16,896 acres; in Nov 2023 SC declared the developer in default of instalments.
possession_status: Many precincts handed over and inhabited; other precincts under development
description: Large private gated town off the M-9 motorway in Malir district, built by Bahria Town from 2014. Its land was the subject of a landmark Supreme Court case ending in a Rs460bn settlement.

sources.title: SC accepts Bahria Town Karachi's Rs460bn offer, halts NAB references (Dawn, 21 Mar 2019)
Bahria Town to pay billions as SC declares it defaulted on installments (Aaj News)

name: Gulshan-e-Iqbal (KDA Scheme 24)
approval_note: Public-sector KDA Scheme 24, developed by KDA from 1966.
possession_status: Fully settled residential and commercial area (Blocks 1-20)
description: KDA Scheme 24, a large planned neighbourhood of Karachi East divided into Blocks 1-20 and named after Allama Iqbal.

name: Gulistan-e-Jauhar (KDA Scheme 36)
approval_note: KDA Scheme 36 (Gulistan-e-Jouhar); gazette notification dated 8 Apr 1985 listed by Shehri.
possession_status: Settled; mostly apartments and houses across numbered blocks
description: KDA residential scheme east of Gulshan-e-Iqbal, made up of numbered blocks with many apartment complexes.

name: KDA Scheme 33 (incl. cooperative housing societies)
developer: KDA / Board of Revenue Sindh, with numerous cooperative housing societies
approval_note: KDA scheme launched 1980 (Dawn 2002). Individual societies within Scheme 33 have varying layout approvals; check each society separately.
possession_status: Mixed: older sectors settled, many societies still developing
description: KDA scheme along the Super Highway hosting many cooperative housing societies; development stalled for about 22 years before restarting in 2002.

sources.title: Nazim kicks off Rs30m project in Scheme-33: 22-year dilemma ends (Dawn, 16 Nov 2002)
Scheme 33 - some societies you should know about (Zameen blog, pointer)

name: North Nazimabad (KDA Scheme 2 / Timuria)
developer: Karachi Improvement Trust / Karachi Development Authority
approval_note: KDA Scheme 2 (Taimooria, North Nazimabad); gazette dated 7 Aug 1964 listed by Shehri; scheme started by KIT in 1958.
possession_status: Fully settled (Blocks A-U)
description: Planned neighbourhood begun in 1958 as KDA Scheme 2, originally to house federal employees. Plot sizes range from 120 sq yd to 3,000 sq yd.

name: Clifton (KDA Scheme 5 / Kehkashan)
approval_authority: Karachi Development Authority (Blocks 8-9 under Clifton Cantonment)
approval_note: KDA Scheme 5 gazette notification of 30 Oct 1964, revised maps 1972 and 1985; SC in 2021 ordered a report on how commercial plots in Kehkashan were created.
possession_status: Fully settled; disputes over amenity/commercial plot conversions
description: KDA Scheme 5 (Kehkashan) covering most of Clifton's numbered blocks; Blocks 8 and 9 fall under Clifton Cantonment.

sources.title: Paper Book (Sch-5 Clifton) - Shehri, for SC order

name: PECHS (Pakistan Employees Cooperative Housing Society)
developer: Pakistan Employees Cooperative Housing Society Ltd
approval_authority: Federal Ministry of Works (land licence); cooperative society
approval_note: Society registered 23 Dec 1947; federal land allotted under 1949 terms and 1958 licence agreement with the Ministry of Works (per Shehri document archive). Licence ended in 1974.
possession_status: Fully settled; heavy commercialisation along main roads
description: One of Karachi's oldest cooperative housing societies, built on federal land in central Karachi. Several main roads were declared commercial in 2004.

name: Naya Nazimabad
approval_note: No official SBCA layout-approval record found. Hospital phase reported to have SBCA architectural approval; Sindh High Court petition (2014) over waste dumping on the site.
possession_status: Partly inhabited; about 6,000 units owned by the public (reported)
description: Private gated scheme near Manghopir built on the former Javedan Cement land. Javedan's 2023 investor briefing gives 1,367 acres of landholding.

name: Navy Housing Scheme Karsaz
approval_note: No public approval record found; scheme on Pakistan Navy land at PNS Karsaz.
possession_status: Settled; NHS Phase-IV high-rise towers designed (NESPAK, 2015)
description: Pakistan Navy residential scheme at Karsaz off Shahrah-e-Faisal. NESPAK designed five high-rise towers on 30 acres of NHS Phase-IV for retired naval officers.

sources.title: Navy Housing Scheme Karachi (NESPAK project page)

name: Taiser Town (MDA Scheme 45)
approval_note: Public-sector MDA scheme; plot balloting held 19 Jul 2019 (about 20,000 successful applicants).
possession_status: Balloted 2019; development pending
description: Malir Development Authority's large public housing scheme in Karachi, with 80-400 sq yd residential plots. Sources disagree on its area (14,466 vs 20,570 acres).

sources.title: Taiser Town Scheme 45 Karachi (Zameen blog, pointer)

name: Citi Housing Faisalabad
approval_note: FDA private-schemes register: 'CITI Housing Scheme Chak No. 234/RB' and 'Chak No. 4&5/JB' Approved; 'Citi Housing Phase-II Chak No. 4/JB' Under Process (checked Oct 2026).
possession_status: Phase I developed; Phase II approval under process
description: Citi Housing's Faisalabad scheme, with FDA-approved sections at Chak 234/RB (Samundri Road side) and Chak 4&5/JB (Sargodha Road side).

name: Eden Valley Faisalabad
approval_note: FDA private-schemes register lists 'Eden Valley, Chak No. 208/RB, 8 Chak Road' as Under Process (checked Oct 2026). Sister schemes Eden Garden, Eden Orchard and Eden Villas are listed Approved.
description: Residential scheme at Chak 208/RB, Faisalabad. FDA warns that utilities are not provided in schemes still under process.

name: WAPDA City Faisalabad
approval_note: FDA register: 'WAPDA City Chak No.192/RB' Approved; 'WAPDA City-II Chak No. 192/RB' Under Process (checked Oct 2026).
possession_status: Phase I developed; WAPDA City-II approval under process
description: Housing scheme at Chak 192/RB off the Canal Road expressway towards the motorway. Phase I is FDA-approved; its extension is still under process.

sources.title: Wapda City Faisalabad area guide (Zameen, pointer)

name: DHA Multan
approval_authority: DHA (chapter of DHA Lahore, under Chief Executive Order No. 26 of 2002)
approval_note: DHA Multan's construction regulations state it is a chapter of DHA Lahore, which is constituted under CEO Order 26 of 2002; outside MDA's private-scheme list.
possession_status: Possession given in Sectors A, H, M, N, Q, R, U, Rumanza and Villas (Jan 2023)
description: Defence Housing Authority's Multan project, including the Rumanza golf community. Sector A (236 acres) was energised from an integrated grid station in 2023.

sources.title: DHA Multan announces possession and electric energization of Sector A (ProPakistani, 18 Jan 2023)
DHA Multan location ballot (Zameen blog, pointer)

approval_note: MDA approved list (Sep 2025): Buch Villas HS 1330 K (24-06-2019), Buch Villas Extension-I 1829 K (19-01-2017), Buch Executive Villas Extension 2191 K (11-12-2020), Buch Executive Villas Phase-II 576.74 K (03-12-2022), Mouza Buch Khusro Abad, Bosan Road. Area below is the sum of these sanctions.

approval_note: MDA approved list (Sep 2025): Citi Housing HS 997.15 K (01-09-2018) and Citi Housing Private Ltd 1898.63 K (24-01-2020), Mouza Lutf Abad, Bosan Road. Area below is the sum.
description: Citi Housing's Multan scheme on Bosan Road in Lutfabad. Bookings opened in June 2020.

name: Royal Orchard Multan
approval_note: MDA approved list (Sep 2025): Royal Orchard HS 1200 K (13-08-2020) and Royal Orchard (Extension) 3190.25 K (24-05-2018), Mouza Durana Langana, Multan Public School Road. Area below is the sum.
description: Gated scheme on Multan Public School Road about 9 km from Multan airport, developed by Habib Rafiq (Pvt) Ltd.

sources.title: MDA Multan - List of Approved Private Housing Schemes / LSDs (PDF, Sep 2025)
Royal Orchard Multan - a guide for genuine buyers (Zameen News, pointer)

name: DHA Peshawar
approval_note: Created by the Defence Housing Authority Peshawar Act 2009 (Act X of 2009, passed Jan 2009); KP housing department notifies its areas. CM approved DHA schemes at Wodpaga and opposite Regi Lalma (Dawn, Jul 2014).
description: DHA's Peshawar project on suburban land at Wodpaga and on Nasir Bagh Road opposite Regi Lalma. Farmers objected to the acquisition of farmland in 2014.

DHA plans housing projects on farmland (Dawn, 5 Jul 2014)

name: Hayatabad Township
approval_note: Public-sector PDA township; Commissioner Peshawar approved expansion into Phases 8 and 9 on about 1,000 acres (The News, 20 Dec 2024).
possession_status: Phases 1-7 settled; Phases 8-9 planned
description: Planned PDA township in western Peshawar, developed from the late 1970s. It has seven phases, each split into sectors A-H.

name: Regi Model Town
approval_note: Public-sector PDA scheme from the early 1990s. Land dispute with the Kukikhel tribe; Peshawar High Court (Apr 2026) directed the DC Peshawar to resolve non-allotment.
possession_status: Only Zones 3 and 4 partly developed; about 17,000 allottees without possession (2023)
description: PDA housing scheme for government employees with five zones. Zones 1, 2 and 5 remain undeveloped because of a long-running tribal land dispute.

name: DHA Gujranwala
approval_note: Not in the GDA private-scheme register (DHA project). No enabling statute or notification was found.
possession_status: Balloted Feb 2019; development work began Apr 2019
description: DHA project launched in 2014 near Rahwali Cantt, with 1,500 acres acquired for Phase I. A 2020 MoU gave ARY Laguna 400 acres inside the society.

sources.title: Development work begins in DHA Gujranwala (Zameen News, pointer)
DHA Gujranwala to get ARY Laguna after Karachi (ARY News)

approval_note: GDA approved register: 'Citi Housing (Phase-I, Ext-I & II) & Illegal Extension' 5760.09 K (approved LOP, Ex. TMA Khiyali Shahpur & GDA) and 'Citi Housing Phase-II' 1042.24 K approved; register itself flags an illegal extension. Area below is the approved total.
description: Citi Housing's flagship scheme on the Upper Chenab Canal Bank Road (Phase I) and G.T. Road (Phase II), Gujranwala.

approval_note: GDA register: 'Master City & Illegal Extension' approved area 2382.87 K (Mouza Kotli Mughlan & Muslim Chak). GDA notice of 19 Nov 2024 says only the approved area is legal and the other extensions are not approved by GDA. Phase I was approved in May 2015.

name: Citi Housing Sialkot

description: Citi Housing scheme in the Daska Road area of Sialkot. Its approval status could not be confirmed from official sources.

sources.title: City Housing Society Sialkot overview (Zameen, pointer)

name: DHA Quetta
approval_note: Created by the Defence Housing Authority Quetta Act 2015 (passed 1 Oct 2015) and amended 2024. BHC struck down some clauses; the Supreme Court later overturned that verdict.
possession_status: Early Bird 1-kanal residential and 5-marla commercial plots handed over (Mar 2023)
description: Defence Housing Authority project in Quetta under a provincial act. Early Bird plots were balloted on 30 Mar 2022 and handed over in 2023.

DHA Quetta hands over possession of Early Bird plots (ProPakistani, 10 Mar 2023)

name: Gulistan-e-Sarmast (HDA scheme)
approval_note: Public-sector HDA scheme announced Dec 2008 on 2,000 acres of the 1992 Kohisar scheme land; SHC case (filed Dec 2018) over possession and use of development funds.
possession_status: Allottees litigating over delayed possession (2019)
description: HDA low-cost scheme in Hyderabad's Kohisar area. About 90 percent of the plots are 100 sq yd and 40 percent of the land is reserved for amenities.

sources.title: HDA launches housing scheme after decade (Dawn, 16 Dec 2008)
Gulistan-e-Sarmast case: SHC issues notices (Zameen News, 10 Mar 2019, pointer)

name: DHA Bahawalpur
approval_note: DHA project. No enabling statute or development-authority approval record was found.
possession_status: Possession of 10-marla plots in Sector C announced Oct 2021; location ballots continuing (2023)
description: DHA project in Bahawalpur set up in 2015. Phase I (about 3,000 acres, Blocks A-N) was to be developed at a cost of PKR 85bn.

sources.title: DHA Bahawalpur schedules 2023 location ballot (ProPakistani, 28 Apr 2023)
DHA Bahawalpur balloted Phase I to cost PKR 85bn (Zameen News, pointer)

name: Abbottabad Smart City
approval_note: Named among housing societies declared illegal by TMA Abbottabad in a public notice (reported 11 Apr 2025) for lacking mandatory approval/NOC.
description: Private society at Dhamtoor, Abbottabad, declared illegal by TMA Abbottabad. TMA says buyers without a valid NOC will not get utility connections.

sources.title: 12 Housing Societies Declared Illegal in Abbottabad (ProPakistani, 11 Apr 2025)

name: Singhar (Sangar) Housing Scheme
approval_authority: Government of Balochistan / Gwadar Development Authority
approval_note: Provincial government scheme: plots allotted in four phases from 1991, with Phase 5 pricing set by the CM (Dawn). GDA (Feb 2017) said development work had begun. No GDA approval/NOC record found.
possession_status: Phase I allottees invited to apply for construction NOCs (Apr 2019)
description: Government-run housing scheme on Koh-e-Batil, Gwadar, in four or more phases. Some allotments were cancelled in the 2000s.

sources.title: Balochistan govt defends Gwadar land allotment (Dawn, 24 Oct 2006)
GDA rubbishes Sangar Housing Scheme rumours (Zameen News, 15 Feb 2017, pointer)
Sangar Housing Scheme invites applications for NOC (Zameen News, 29 Apr 2019, pointer)
Committee to assess losses of Singhar allottees whose allotments were cancelled (Dawn)

name: Model Town Sargodha (SDA)
developer: Sargodha Development Authority (formerly Sargodha Improvement Trust)
approval_note: Public-sector scheme launched by Sargodha Improvement Trust in 1990-91 (Dawn, Nov 2004), now run by SDA.
possession_status: Long-delayed; SDA said in Jan 2020 that development would begin within two months
description: Government scheme about 7 km from Sargodha city, troubled for years by irregular allotments and stalled development. SDA cited 3,200 plots on 1,600 acres in 2020.

sources.title: SARGODHA: Auction of plots in Model Town scheme stopped (Dawn, 8 Nov 2004)
Development of Model Town Sargodha to begin in two months (Zameen News, 22 Jan 2020, pointer)

name: Royal Orchard Sargodha
approval_authority: Divisional Commissioner Sargodha / Metropolitan Corporation Sargodha
approval_note: 'Royal Orchard' is among the 38 schemes declared illegal within Sargodha metropolitan corporation limits by the Divisional Commissioner, with sale and transfer of plots banned (Dawn, 30 Aug 2023).
possession_status: Plot sale/transfer banned (Aug 2023)
description: Housing scheme in Sargodha listed as illegal in 2023. Dawn does not name its developer, so it should not be assumed to be linked to Royal Orchard Multan.

name: F-6
approval_note: CDA-planned sector of Islamabad (public-sector master plan), not a private housing scheme, so it is not on CDA's approved/unapproved private-scheme lists.
description: One of Islamabad's original CDA sectors at the foot of the Margalla Hills; its markaz is Super Market. Sub-sectors F-6/1 to F-6/4.

name: F-7
approval_note: CDA-planned sector of Islamabad (public-sector master plan), not a private housing scheme, so it is not on CDA's approved/unapproved private-scheme lists.
description: Central CDA sector of Islamabad between F-6 and F-8; its markaz, Jinnah Super Market, is one of the city's main shopping areas.

name: F-8
approval_note: CDA-planned sector of Islamabad (public-sector master plan), not a private housing scheme, so it is not on CDA's approved/unapproved private-scheme lists.
description: CDA sector bounded by Margalla Avenue/E-8 (north), Faisal Avenue/F-7 (east), Jinnah Avenue/G-8 (south) and Ninth Avenue/F-9 park (west); five sub-sectors.

name: F-11
approval_note: CDA-planned sector of Islamabad (public-sector master plan), not a private housing scheme, so it is not on CDA's approved/unapproved private-scheme lists.
description: Western CDA sector of Islamabad's F series below the Margalla Hills, with its own markaz and sub-sectors F-11/1 to F-11/4.

name: G-13
approval_note: CDA-planned sector of Islamabad (public-sector master plan), not a private housing scheme, so it is not on CDA's approved/unapproved private-scheme lists.
description: CDA sector in Islamabad's western G series near Golra Sharif, with sub-sectors G-13/1 to G-13/4.

name: I-8
approval_note: CDA-planned sector of Islamabad (public-sector master plan), not a private housing scheme, so it is not on CDA's approved/unapproved private-scheme lists.
description: CDA sector in Islamabad's I series near the Faizabad interchange, with a central markaz and sub-sectors I-8/1 to I-8/4. Coordinates are the I-8 Markaz node in OSM.

name: Satellite Town
approval_note: Older planned neighbourhood and union council of Rawalpindi city; not on RDA's private-scheme lists, so no list status assigned.
description: Planned neighbourhood and union council of Rawalpindi close to Islamabad, home to Rawalpindi Women University, Barani Institute of IT and a Rawalpindi Medical College campus.

name: Westridge
approval_note: Per Wikipedia, the Cantonment Board allowed three schemes (Westridge 1, 2 and 3) in 1960, launched by the Army Housing Directorate. Not on RDA's private-scheme lists; no status assigned.
description: Cantonment residential area of Rawalpindi made up of Westridge 1, 2 and 3, laid out from 1960 for army and civilian personnel; among the city's pricier neighbourhoods.

name: Chaklala Scheme III
approval_note: Residential scheme inside Chaklala Cantonment (per OSM); no public approval-list entry found, so no status assigned.
description: Residential scheme in Chaklala Cantonment near the old Rawalpindi airport, known for its large commercial market with restaurants, shops and a cinema.

name: Askari 14
approval_note: Askari-branded scheme; developer attribution rests on the Askari name and AWT's listed 'Askari Housing Schemes', not an authority list. No status assigned.
description: Gated Askari housing scheme in Rawalpindi beside Gulshanabad, off Adyala Road.

name: Airport Housing Society
approval_note: No public approval-list entry found; no status assigned.
description: Residential society in Rawalpindi near Koral Chowk and the Islamabad Expressway, east of the old Benazir Bhutto airport.

name: Gulberg
approval_note: Long-established Lahore neighbourhood (Gulberg I–V), not a private scheme on LDA's lists; no status assigned.
description: Upscale residential and business district of central Lahore (Gulberg I–V) around Main Boulevard, MM Alam Road and Liberty Market; Lahore's main business district.

name: Lahore Cantt
approval_authority: Lahore Cantonment Board (Military Lands & Cantonments Department)
approval_note: Independent cantonment municipality, not an LDA scheme; no list status assigned.
description: Lahore's garrison cantonment, an independent municipality under the Military Lands & Cantonments Department, made up largely of upscale housing schemes and markets.

name: Allama Iqbal Town
approval_note: Opened to the public in April 1982 (Wikipedia, which credits Hassan Zaman Pvt Ltd with its development). Not on LDA's private-scheme lists; no status assigned.
description: Large planned scheme in Lahore's Iqbal zone, once called 'Sola Sau Acre' after its 1,600 acres; 22 named blocks off Multan Road, with Karim Block Market and Moon Market.

name: Township
approval_note: Township planned in the Ayub Khan era; not on LDA's private-scheme lists; no status assigned.
description: One of Lahore's largest residential neighbourhoods (UC 132–133), planned under the Ayub Khan administration, with sectors such as C-1 and C-II and Model Bazar.

name: Cavalry Ground
approval_note: Governed directly by the Lahore Cantonment Board (Walton Cantonment); no list status assigned.
description: Cantonment neighbourhood linking DHA and Gulberg, with residential streets and a commercial strip along Masood Anwari Road.

name: Gulshan-e-Ravi
approval_note: Established residential neighbourhood; not on LDA's private-scheme lists; no status assigned.
description: Residential neighbourhood in Lahore's Samanabad zone on the old course of the River Ravi, divided into blocks A–H.

name: Federal B Area
developer: Federal government housing scheme for government employees
approval_note: Housing scheme for federal employees initiated in 1953 under PM Muhammad Ali Bogra (Wikipedia); no SBCA/KDA list status assigned.
description: Large residential area of central Karachi begun in 1953 to house federal employees; 22 blocks with local names such as Azizabad, Dastagir, Naseerabad and Ancholi.

name: Malir Cantonment
approval_note: Cantonment governed under the Cantonments Act 1924; not a KDA/SBCA scheme; no list status assigned.
description: Military cantonment and residential area in east Karachi, declared in 1941 and taken over by the Pakistan Army in 1947; it contains Askari 5 and other service housing.

name: North Karachi
approval_note: Large planned township (New Karachi Town); no KDA/SBCA list status assigned.
description: Large township (New Karachi) between the Lyari River, the Manghopir hills, Surjani Road and Shahrah-e-Zahid Hussain, organised in numbered sectors.

name: Bahadurabad
approval_note: Long-established neighbourhood of Gulshan Town; no list status assigned.
description: Central Karachi neighbourhood named after Bahadur Yar Jung, settled after 1947 largely by migrants from Hyderabad Deccan; known for its Charminar replica roundabout (2007).

name: Gulshan-e-Maymar
approval_note: Private township launched in 1980, in MDA Scheme 45 and partly Scheme 33 (Wikipedia); no SBCA/MDA list status found.
description: Master-planned private township off the M-9 Super Highway, launched in 1980 and grown through 13 phases to 1,023 acres, planned for about 100,000 residents.

name: Defence View
approval_note: Neighbourhood adjoining DHA, not a DHA phase; no list status assigned.
description: Neighbourhood beside DHA in Karachi (Phases 1–3), home to Iqra University's main campus and near the start of the Malir Expressway. Coordinates are Defence View Phase 2 (OSM).
